title: BeefyBun's SMP Modpack
description: This modpack add a lot of utility mod to make the game better .
body:
✨ Ultimate Optimized PvP & Survival Modpack – Smooth, Stylish, Powerful
Dive into a fully‑optimized Minecraft experience built for players who want performance, clean visuals, and PvP-ready precision. This modpack combines hand‑picked optimization mods, useful quality‑of‑life texture packs, and sleek custom visuals to create a game that feels smoother, sharper, and more responsive than vanilla ever could.

🔥 Features
High FPS Optimization – Carefully selected performance mods for buttery‑smooth gameplay, even on lower-end systems.

Useful Texture Packs – Enhanced visuals that stay faithful to Minecraft while improving clarity, readability, and immersion.

PvP Enhancements – Subtle but powerful PvP mods that improve timing, hit detection feel, and overall combat awareness.

Cool Custom Textures – Stylish blocks, items, and UI elements that make your world look fresh without losing the classic vibe.

🎮 Perfect For
Competitive PvP players

Survival enjoyers who want smoother gameplay

Anyone who wants Minecraft to look and run better
